# Notling

> A fast, open-source, local-first Notion alternative built with React 19, TanStack Start, Yjs CRDTs, and PostgreSQL.

## Overview
Notling is a distraction-free, high-performance workspace designed for notes, docs, databases, and knowledge bases. It combines block-based rich text editing with real-time peer-to-peer collaboration, offline PWA capabilities, and database tables.

## Core Capabilities
- **Block-Based Editor**: Slash commands, markdown shortcuts, rich text formatting, nested lists, callouts, tables, and code blocks.
- **Real-Time Collaboration**: Multi-user concurrent editing powered by Yjs Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) and WebRTC signaling.
- **Database & Spreadsheets**: Flexible database views with customizable columns, row filtering, sorting, and form collection.
- **Local-First & Offline Ready**: Progressive Web App (PWA) with client-side caching, background sync, and offline persistence.
- **Knowledge Organization**: Unlimited nested page hierarchies, workspace switching, folder grouping, and instant fuzzy search.
- **Data Portability**: Full data ownership with one-click export to Markdown and PDF.
- **Find and Replace**: In-document keyboard navigation and batch search/replace.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 19, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, BlockNote, ProseMirror, Lucide & HugeIcons
- Backend: TanStack Start, Nitro, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM
- Sync & Realtime: Yjs, WebRTC, BroadcastChannel
